basis: cards with rarity "starter exclusive" in src/assets/*.json
caveat: Products are inferred from card rarity; names and dates come from the curated table in scripts/derive-precons.mjs and are null where no source was found. `label` is descriptive, not a catalogue title. A starter-exclusive character is NOT a deck: the Mega Man and Darkstalkers tins paired one fixed deck with booster packs, so the set's other exclusive characters came from those packs. `hadDeck` is true/false only where a source says so.
